quotes.text: ClinEnv is built from MIMIC-IV v3.1 ( Johnson et al., 2023a ) and MIMIC-IV-Note v2.2 ( Johnson et al., 2023b ).

parsed.rationale: Source data are version-pinned, but evaluation relies on live external services (the RxNorm API, embedding retrieval and LLM rerankers/judges) and the environment agents and judge are identified only by family name in the paper. This matches the 1 anchor: data pinned, evaluators or services live or unpinned.
